g.title: plan
g.text: clone input; active pointer/payload/entry and npm snapshot
protect owned paths; external config metadata only

g.title: native
g.text: openGlobalPathGuard owns native ancestors + object pins
POSIX openat / xattr / ACL / no-replace rename
Windows retained handles / SID-DACL / relative native calls

g.title: check
g.text: consumer / actual writer / unreadable assessment -> stop
external Claude config writer -> observation only

g.title: prepare
g.text: repeat fresh checks; private run + evidence
exclusive installer lock + fresh canonical chained journal

g.title: originals
g.text: Preservation engine owns original object state
rename originals into private run; preserve identity + bytes

g.title: copies
g.text: Create and verify distinct-inode working copies
release only working pins before npm child

g.title: unknown
g.text: Issued syscall / receipt / cleanup not confirmed
unknown + private evidence + fresh recovery-plan entry

g.title: npm
g.text: Owned Node/npm child; offline + ignore-scripts + empty npmrc
60 s hang guard; bounded output hash only

g.title: inspect
g.text: only same known content/identity or deletion accepted
completed receipt + non-management leaves absent -> removed

g.title: shell
g.text: Publish product-generated wrappers then shell manifest

g.title: readback
g.text: Coordinator checkpoint -> archive lock -> close guard
